bagPolicy.summary: Backpacks, suitcases and bags larger than A3 are not allowed in the event area. Smaller bags are permitted.
prohibited: Chains, ropes or strings longer than 20cm
bagPolicy.note: From the Progresja regulations, which cover all events organized or co-organized by Progresja at Fort Wola 22. Oversized bags must be left in the cloakroom, if one is available, when security asks.

parking.note: No specific parking options or pricing information is provided on the website. Visitors are encouraged to plan their arrival in advance.

rideshare.note: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by Letnia Scena Progresji. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.note: The venue features 4 bars serving both alcoholic and non-alcoholic drinks, with all beverages provided in plastic cups for safety. Cash and card payments are accepted.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Letnia Scena Progresji, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Letnia Scena Progresji's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Letnia Scena Progresji. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Letnia Scena Progresji. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
